narrative:
Toledo municipal court district has 178,500 registered voters, with 63.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 8.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 27.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 19.1 percentage points. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +14.4% D−R vs +33.7% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
